use_case: Berth and yard scheduling optimization (SYS-12): recommended berth windows and crane splits, yard slots for arriving containers, and truck appointment slot allocations at T1
vendor_or_model: Scheduling optimization SaaS vendor (mathematical optimization with machine-learning predictions of dwell and move times)
data_categories: Vessel schedules; bay plans; container attributes including hazardous class and weight; yard inventory; equipment status; truck appointments with trucking company and driver names (Confidential)
human_in_the_loop: Planner approves every berth and yard plan in the TOS; independent constraint check in the TOS blocks unsafe plans (due 2026-11-30); appointment slot recommendations suspended
applicable_laws: 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F (101.650(b)(3); 101.650(f)(1)-(3)); 46 U.S.C. 41106; OSHA 29 CFR part 1917; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production at T1 since 2026-03 (advisory mode); approved with conditions; appointment slot recommendations suspended; T2 expansion paused

use_case: Gate optical character recognition of container, chassis and license plate numbers at the OCR portals of all three gates (SYS-02)
vendor_or_model: OCR vendor (computer vision models on company-owned OCR servers)
data_categories: Container, chassis and plate images and numbers; timestamps (Internal; plates alone are not personal information under Fla. Stat. 501.171)
human_in_the_loop: Gate clerk resolves every misread or mismatch before the transaction completes; customs hold check is rule-based in the TOS
applicable_laws: 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F (critical IT; 101.650(e)(3)(i), (f)); 33 CFR 105.265(a)(7); OCR vendor data terms needed
status: In production since 2023 at T1, 2025 at T2 and the depot; approved with conditions

use_case: Crane predictive maintenance analytics: models on STS, RTG and mobile harbor crane drive and sensor data predict component failures and suggest maintenance
vendor_or_model: Crane analytics SaaS vendor (machine-learning anomaly detection); outbound connector from the T1 crane management system
build_or_buy: Buy (adopted by the Maintenance and Engineering department in 2026-01 without a security review)
data_categories: Crane drive, load and vibration telemetry; fault codes; maintenance history (Internal; OT data)
human_in_the_loop: Maintenance planner reviews every suggestion; OEM inspection intervals remain mandatory and are never extended because of a model score
applicable_laws: 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F (101.650(f)(1); 101.650(h)(1)-(2)); OSHA 29 CFR part 1917; FTC Act Section 5 (vendor claims)
status: In production at T1 (pilot on 7 STS cranes and 8 RTGs); approved with conditions; T2 connection not allowed until the T2 OT zone exists

use_case: Perimeter video analytics: detection of people and vehicles crossing perimeter zones at T1 from 46 cameras, alerting the security control room (SYS-09)
vendor_or_model: CCTV integrator (video analytics module on the company video management servers)
build_or_buy: Buy (added with the 2025 CCTV upgrade without a security review)
data_categories: Video of people and vehicles at the perimeter (SSI-adjacent: camera coverage details); no facial recognition; no audio
human_in_the_loop: Security officer assesses every alert on screen and dispatches a patrol; patrols and CCTV recording continue regardless of analytics
applicable_laws: 33 CFR Part 105 FSP security measures for monitoring (105.405(a)(14)); 33 CFR Part 101 Subpart F (101.650(b)(3)); 49 CFR 1520.5 (security measures details); Fla. Stat. 501.171 if facial recognition (biometric data) were ever enabled
status: In production at T1; approved with conditions; facial recognition prohibited

use_case: Enterprise generative AI assistant in the productivity suite for drafting, summarizing and searching office documents and email
vendor_or_model: Productivity suite vendor's generative AI assistant (large language model) under the enterprise agreement
build_or_buy: Buy (enterprise license; contract reviewed by IT in 2026-06)
data_categories: Email, documents and chat the user can already access; risk of SSI, personal information or customs data in prompts
